Name: (JA) Steven Universe Foods
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Here we are in the future! A future full of all of the delicious and nutritionally suspicious foods from Steven Universe that I could think of making (or had the mental capacity to sprite and make) 

This features:

- 13 Cookable items

- 1 new tree and resulting fruit

- 7 drinks with unique effects

All items you can cook can be made with vanilla items to prevent people from needing a bunch of other mods. 

This has compatibility with [i]A LOT[/i] of NPCs, including Ridgeside, Stardew Valley Expanded, Down Town Zuzu, and East Scarp! 

Please enjoy!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.

[/b]Note: I moved the CP/1.6 version to another mod as it felt more proper that way :)
